overview.title: Cybersecurity Built for
overview.description: Cyber threats are becoming more sophisticated, targeting businesses of every size and industry. RCS Infra Tech delivers comprehensive cybersecurity solutions that secure networks, cloud environments, endpoints, applications, and sensitive business data. Our proactive, security-first approach helps organisations minimise risk, maintain compliance, and operate with confidence in an increasingly connected world.
overview.DescRight: Modern cyberattacks evolve rapidly. Building a resilient cybersecurity strategy requires continuous visibility, proactive defence, and rapid response to minimise business disruption and protect critical assets.

service.title: Endpoint Security

service.title: Email Security
service.description: Reduce phishing, spam, malware, spoofing, and business email compromise through intelligent email filtering and advanced threat protection.

service.title: IoT Security
service.description: Secure connected devices, industrial equipment, and smart infrastructure by identifying vulnerabilities and monitoring device communications.

service.title: Penetration Testing (VAPT)
service.description: Identify security weaknesses before attackers do through structured vulnerability assessments and controlled penetration testing.

service.title: Identity & Access Management

service.title: Security Operations Center (SOC)
service.description: 24×7 security monitoring, threat intelligence, incident detection, investigation, and rapid response to minimise cyber risks.

service.title: Cloud Security

faqSection.title: Cybersecurity
faqSection.subtitle: Answers to common questions about enterprise cybersecurity services.

items.question: Why is cybersecurity important?
items.answer: Cybersecurity protects business systems, sensitive information and digital infrastructure from cyber threats while ensuring business continuity.

items.question: Do you provide SOC services?
items.answer: Yes. We provide 24×7 Security Operations Centre (SOC) monitoring, incident detection and rapid response.

items.question: Which industries do you support?
items.answer: We deliver cybersecurity solutions for healthcare, banking and financial services, manufacturing, government, education, retail, logistics, and enterprise organisations, tailoring our approach to each industry's unique security and compliance requirements.

items.question: Do you provide compliance and regulatory support?
items.answer: Yes. We help organisations align their cybersecurity strategy with industry regulations and compliance frameworks through security assessments, governance, risk management, policy development, and continuous monitoring.

items.question: Can small and medium-sized businesses benefit from enterprise cybersecurity?
items.answer: Absolutely. Cyber threats affect organisations of all sizes. We offer scalable cybersecurity solutions that provide enterprise-grade protection while aligning with the budget, infrastructure, and operational needs of small and medium-sized businesses.

items.question: How do I get started with your cybersecurity services?
items.answer: Getting started is simple. Contact our cybersecurity specialists to schedule a consultation. We'll assess your current security posture, understand your business requirements, identify potential risks, and recommend a tailored cybersecurity strategy that supports your goals.
